**Other relevant information**
• Position slaving vehicle and disabled vehicle close enough for cable hookup. [Manual page 185]
• Stop slaving vehicle engine. [Manual page 185]
• Ensure all battery cables in disabled vehicle are properly connected before connecting slave cable. [Manual page 185]
• Use a twisting motion when installing slave cable to the receptacle. [Manual page 185]
• Ensure all electrical switches in both vehicles are turned off. [Manual page 185]
• Use a twisting motion when disconnecting slave cable from the receptacle. [Manual page 185]
